Message:
drm/panel: simple: Add support for PDA 91-00156-A0 panel

PDA 91-00156-A0 5.0 is a 5.0" WVGA TFT LCD panel. This panel with
backlight is found in PDA 5" LCD screen (TM5000 series or AC320005-5).
